_about: Still cameras for meshy_village_look.py --views-file: name -> [[eye x, eye y, eye height], [target x, target y, target z], lens mm, options]. x and y are corner tile units (the look's tile_xy: a tile's centre is +0.5), the eye height is above HM_Ground (absolute world z from 25 m up), the target z is world z. Options: cut_z cuts the cave rock away above that height (P_cut_z), hide hides the named objects from the camera for that view (their shadows stay; a fog or haze volume is left out of the render). Read by meshy_wild_build.sharpen_near_views (the look ignores them): clear [[tile x, tile y, r], ...] removes the trees within r metres of those points from the scene, cone (metres, default 4.5) removes every tree that near the eye inside the frame's width, lod_r (a high view) gives the trees within that many metres of its eye at least the 0.6 master, full_r gives the trees in a low view's frame within that many metres the full near master, veil [[tile x, tile y, r], ...] names the trees within r metres of those points HM_veil_<view>_<k> (for that view's hide: gone from that still only, their shadows stay), cone_lens works the cone out at that lens. show (read by the look) brings in objects the build leaves out of the render, such as the grotto still's own lights.
